text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto isn't feeling well, so I take her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I pr-promise to rest and get my health back… Urgh, good night…

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Leader Doto, welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep?! L-l-leader?! I'm the leader?!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Leader, your hairstyle is off the rails! You've really styled it up!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: C-could you please stop calling me that?!
Oh! You would disregard my claim to said title… Have you forgotten your place?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Try Sin Academy's only big enough for one tyrant! I hereby challenge you for the throne!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaagh?! But, but, but why?! Are you asking me to do something violent?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um… I don't want to battle it out! I'll g-give the position of leader to you, okay?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh? You stand in the fray of battle desiring peace… Your kindness knows no bounds!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …I am smitten with your inner strength! From this day forward, we are comrades. I shall have it that we are both leaders!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what does that mean?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We will rule over this school and make it a place overflowing with glee. Now come, join me in laughter, Doto!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: HAAAH HA HA HA!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Haaaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hah?! W-wait, did I just—it's not what it sounds like, I was just having a dream and, and…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O was there and… Ehehe…
Meisho Doto must have had a good dream. Her fatigue has been sent packing!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself! The victor of this conflict shall be decided via a battle of monologues! Let the "Script Factor" begin!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Desert this place and return nevermore! Begone, begone, begone!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… Dessert this place and… never return more! Be… be… gone… Be gum… B-begun!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Noooo! I can't do it! That wasn't even close to correct!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sniff! Even my dreams aren't safe from my slipups…
Meisho Doto's nightmare does nothing to improve her condition.
